new_material_candidates.name: Meta-TTL
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Explicitly meta-learns a test-time adaptation policy for language agents and reports zero-shot application to unseen agent tasks.

new_material_candidates.name: Test-Time Environment Decomposition
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Introduces label-free test-time environment decomposition and releases training, evaluation, trajectories, and trained-model assets for realistic web-agent adaptation.

new_material_candidates.name: TTRV
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Applies reinforcement learning directly at inference time to unlabeled VLM test examples using self-derived reward signals, a materially distinct adaptation mechanism absent from the existing pool.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Meta-TTL
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns an adaptation policy over training tasks and applies the learned meta-prompt to unseen language-agent tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The demonstrated transfer remains within language-agent environments and does not span Hetren E1, E2, and E3.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Relational Task Extrapolator
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Learns relational task transformations for structured task extrapolation.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The verified experiments do not establish one common decision-transfer mechanism across Hetren's three environment families.

n_h2_reference_research.name: Learning-To-Measure
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Meta-learns active feature acquisition behavior over structured-data tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Its transfer scope remains structured-data active feature acquisition.

screened_not_promoted.name: Additional E2 AFA methods
